removals_breakdown.description: Products logged with zero or negative price values (promotional anomalies, system zero-fills, or checkout recording errors) were eliminated to safeguard revenue calculations.

Records filtered due to combined conditions including malformed timestamp parsing, unparseable event strings, or duplicate drop passes in historical PySpark scripts without granular per-condition tags.

categorical_missingness.impact: No records deleted. Missing taxonomy strings were retained to preserve exact transaction volume and platform GMV without introducing artificial taxonomy classifications.
No records deleted. Unbranded products (white-label electronics, generic accessories) were tracked as an explicit aggregate to prevent skewing branded market share metrics.

deduplication_audit.full_data_action: Executed distributed PySpark dropDuplicates() across all 9 schema columns
deduplication_audit.methodological_caveat: Reconciliation of sample audits: Historical 1% random sample audit (424,129 records) observed 0 duplicates. Secondary 1M-event contiguous block audit identified 28 duplicates (0.0028% collision rate). Full-corpus deduplication via PySpark dropDuplicates() is mathematically bounded within the 98,890 net filtered rows (together with 68,673 price <= 0 rows and 30,217 unsegregated remainder).

cleaning_pipeline_stages.name: Schema Enforcement & Typing
cleaning_pipeline_stages.notes: Coerced CSV string columns into explicit PySpark datatypes: TimestampType, LongType, DoubleType, and StringType.

cleaning_pipeline_stages.name: Non-Positive Price Elimination
cleaning_pipeline_stages.notes: Eliminated 68,673 records where price <= 0.00 to guarantee financial integrity across all sales and revenue views.

cleaning_pipeline_stages.name: Multi-Condition & Anomaly Cleansing
cleaning_pipeline_stages.notes: Quarantined 30,217 records with unparseable telemetry formats, invalid session boundaries, or duplicate collisions.

cleaning_pipeline_stages.name: Categorical Null Preservation
cleaning_pipeline_stages.notes: Preserved 13.5M unclassified categories and 6.1M unbranded products as explicit tokens without row loss.

cleaning_pipeline_stages.name: Verified Cleaned Baseline Landing
cleaning_pipeline_stages.notes: Persisted 42,349,874 verified records to Snappy-compressed Parquet on HDFS for downstream analytical processing.
